note: A wand shot that bursts into four smaller bursts at the target (the clusters are folded into one burst).

def.name: Scatter Bolt
def.description: A wand shot that bursts apart where it lands.

note: An arrow that is half lightning and arcs to up to three other enemies near the target, with a stronger shock.

def.name: Storm Arrow
def.description: An arrow of lightning that arcs from the target to enemies nearby.

note: A melee strike; when it lands, bolts of lightning fly out from the weapon in an arc, each hitting for three quarters of the strike.

def.name: Bolt Cleave
def.description: A strike that, when it lands, sends bolts of lightning flying from your weapon in an arc.

note: A channelled pulse of lightning around the caster that grows every fourth pulse (the larger pulse is averaged).

def.name: Crackle Ring
def.description: Lightning crackles around you in pulses while you channel.

note: A melee strike, mostly fire; when it lands, molten balls are thrown to the ground around the enemy and burst there, each for half the strike.

def.name: Slag Blow
def.description: A strike that, when it lands, splatters molten metal on the ground around the enemy.

note: Puts an orb of storm by the character for six seconds, in place of the one before; it strikes the nearest enemy in reach with lightning that splits to two to four more, and a lightning skill cast inside it makes it strike once more.

def.name: Tempest Mote
def.description: A mote of storm that strikes the nearest enemy with lightning that splits to others.

note: Spears rise from the ground in sequence ahead: six spikes at 65% less damage each in Blood Stance, one wide thrust in Sand Stance. No bleed.

def.name: Spear Burst
def.description: Spears burst from the ground ahead of you, six in a row in Blood Stance, one wide thrust in Sand Stance.

note: A claw or dagger strike that poisons heavily; an enemy it struck that dies while poisoned sets off a poisonous cloud on the enemies around it.

def.name: Venom Strike
def.description: A strike that poisons its target heavily.

note: A wand volley that culls weak enemies and gains Insight charges from strong ones.

def.name: Mind Drain
def.description: A volley of bolts that finishes weak enemies and draws Insight from the strong.

note: A shot with a bow or a stab with a blade that always bleeds; the bleed lasts eight seconds and lengthens with skill effect duration.

def.name: Gouge Shot
def.description: A stab or a shot that always makes the target bleed for a long while.

note: A wide volley that falls on an area (modelled as a ground zone that pulses once).

def.name: Arrow Shower
def.description: Arrows fall in a wide shower on a target area.

note: A sweep of the weapon in a frontal arc: each use that hits builds a stage, 50% more area (four at most); with nothing hit for three seconds the stages fade, one a second.

def.name: Sweeping Cut
def.description: A sweep that grows broader with every use that hits.

note: A channelled ray of fire that sets a burning debuff on what it touches: each breath it stays in the ray adds a stage (eight at most, each adding three fifths of the first), and at the last stage the enemy is exposed to fire. It keeps burning for a moment after it leaves the ray. The ray does not hit.

def.name: Searing Lance
def.description: A ray of fire that burns hotter the longer it stays on the target, and leaves it exposed.

note: Three steel shards in a fixed fan, each bursting where it hits; the farther a shard has flown the harder it hits, and several can hit one close enemy.

def.name: Splinter Volley
def.description: A spread of steel shards that burst where they land, and hit harder the farther they fly.

note: Two rings of lightning that expand from the caster, with a stronger shock.

def.name: Static Ring
def.description: A ring of lightning that spreads from you and shocks harder than most.

note: A cloud of erratic sparks that fly in all directions for two seconds.

def.name: Skitter Flash
def.description: Sends out sparks that skitter about in every direction.

note: Throws a spectral weapon that flies out and back, hitting on both legs.

def.name: Phantom Toss
def.description: Throws a phantom copy of your weapon that flies out and comes back.

note: A lightning strike; each hit gives a stack of a four-second buff (up to three), and while it lasts beams strike the enemies near the character every 0.4 seconds, more often with each stack, for much less damage while standing still.

def.name: Charged Blow
def.description: A strike that fills you with lightning: beams strike the enemies about you for a while.

note: Sets a marker where it is aimed; a second and a half later the marker is struck once by lightning, and every other marker with it.

def.name: Skyfall
def.description: Marks the ground; the mark is struck by lightning, and sets off every other mark with it.

note: A slam that sends a wave of broken ground straight ahead; each enemy it strikes sets off a shockwave that hits the others about it for 60% less damage.

def.name: Rupture Line
def.description: A slam that sends a wave of broken ground ahead, each enemy it strikes setting off a shockwave.
